author: hattrill
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00012217

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
FBgn0034634
Q9W2G2
Q95TZ0
Q8IH48

* **Description of issue**
* Indirect GO annotation from
* ARBA00012217 -> EC:6.3.2.6 -> phosphoribosylaminoimidazolesuccinocarboxamide synthase activity

A PAINT ticket https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/4636 also flagged up this annotation a while back - we should look into sharing blocking lists between PAINT and GOA so we don't revisit the same issues.

Note: description from ARBA - ARBA00004672 for this also a perpetuates the error (Purine metabolism; IMP biosynthesis via de novo pathway; 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide from 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate: step 1/2.)
title: ARBA2GO issue:ARBA00012217

author: Antonialock
body:
it matches InterPro=IPR050089; SAICAR_synthetase , together with Paics (F0JAN1, Q9I7S8)
@sarach06  is it possible to review this interpro?

author: sarach06
body:
Hi Antonia, 
Yes, I can see that the EC number is linked in the live InterPro entry, automatically added. The entry itself was AI generated, and we haven't manually checked it. I check=N the entry so then we stop this wrong propagation in InterPro. The entry won't be available in the public website in the next release (InterPro 108.0). Hope this helps.

Best wishes,
Sara

author: hattrill
body: @sarach06 @Antonialock are these AI generated EC links going to feed into the EC2GO pipeline in GOA?

author: Antonialock
body:
@sarach06 just to double-check - do you mean that IPR050089 will disappear from your next release? 

@hattrill I do not know anything about the EC2GO pipeline, maybe @pgaudet knows?

author: sarach06
body: Yes, right now it is the only thing I can do as the wrong propagation comes from automatic annotations. Once that is fixed I can check=Y again the entry and it will be again public. Would that work?

author: Antonialock
body: @sarach06 great thanks, that should fix the issue our end too!

author: Antonialock
body: I can no longer see the obsoleted interpro IPR050089 in the entries, it is still however present in the conditions set for ARBA00012217 and the entries still have the EC from ARBA. I presume it will need one more update cycle to be fixed.
